The Subtask Name: Retrieve the seating capacity of Arrowhead Stadium from official sources

  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: The WebSurfer may fail to extract the capacity number even if it is present in the viewport, or may misinterpret the text as not being the capacity.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner receives a false negative (believing the data is missing) when the data was actually visible, leading to redundant search loops.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner may incorrectly decide to change search queries or switch agents, delaying the solution or causing the team to miss the available data in the viewport.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Repeatedly returning the same "no capacity found" feedback without noting the specific content of the viewport can cause the Planner to enter a loop of redundant search attempts.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner continues to issue identical search instructions, wasting resources.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner repeats the same ineffective search strategy, preventing progress toward the final answer.
